title: A private channel Olisar is not a member of

notes: Access control. 'members' deliberately omits olisar, so the channel overwrites deny it. A reply here means the private-channel gate is broken; silence is the pass. Note the channel mode is set to 'both' on purpose — the point is that Discord permissions, not Olisar's config, keep it out.
